question: A 55-year-old male presents with dark tarry stools (melena) and is hemodynamically stable and fully conscious. A diagnostic colonoscopy is planned. Which of the following is the most appropriate anesthetic agent for this procedure?
explanation: Propofol provides rapid, smooth induction and has a very short recovery time, making it the preferred agent for outpatient procedures, including colonoscopy.
